title: Forever, n times, or until?
instruction: Which loop will the micro:bit use?

items.text: The heart flashes exactly three times
items.why: You know in advance how many times.

items.text: A tune plays until someone presses a button
items.why: The end depends on what happens.

items.text: The temperature is shown all day
items.why: The device is meant to run until you switch it off.

items.text: The buzzer beeps five times in a row
The buggy drives forward until it bumps into something
items.why: How far it goes depends on where the obstacle is.

items.text: The step counter counts steps the whole time it is on
items.why: It is always watching; the loop has no reason to end.

debrief: Forever for a device that is meant to keep running. N times for an exact count. Until for an end that depends on what happens.
